request.description: A fog-bound old graveyard, crooked weathered headstones scattered over uneven bare earth, a tall wrought iron fence enclosing the cemetery, an open iron gate, and a winding dirt path between graves disappearing into thick fog. No fountain, houses, vehicles or people.
